items.prompt: A farmer has 35 hens and two sevenths are brown. Build a part-whole model with 7 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Sevenths mean 7 equal units in the whole.
Brown is 2 units and white is the other 5 units.
items.explanation: 35 divided by 7 is 5, so one unit is 5 hens. Brown is 2 units, which is 10 hens.

items.prompt: A tank holds 48 litres and is five eighths full. Build a part-whole model with 8 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Eighths mean 8 equal units in the whole.
Water is 5 units and the empty space is 3 units.
items.explanation: 48 divided by 8 is 6, so one unit is 6 litres. The water is 5 units, which is 30 litres.

items.prompt: A book has 90 pages and Lola has read three tenths. Build a part-whole model with 10 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Tenths mean 10 equal units in the whole.
Read is 3 units and not read is 7 units.
items.explanation: 90 divided by 10 is 9, so one unit is 9 pages. Lola has read 3 units, which is 27 pages.
